(2) Three matrix rows rest on one ancient author (psalm: Augustine, English only; entrance antiphon: Jerome; communion B: Augustine). No Greek manuscript was examined. (5) Whether the printed US Lectionary omits the last colon of Psalm 25:5 is unresolved. (8) No witness was collated with a modern critical text.
